summary: Open images of active amoeboid cells exist (Cell Image Library Dictyostelium time series such as CIL:812, CC0; BioImage Archive migration datasets S-BIAD901 and S-BIAD3674), and S-BIAD598 gives 1,075 fixed SEM images of protists with taxonomy, but no dataset pairs cell shape with an independent activity/rest label or follows naked amoebae through encystment, and none records cortical tension. The active-phase side is illustrated; the resting/encysting side and the tension variable are missing.
next_step: Record or locate time-lapse of a free-living amoeba (e.g., Acanthamoeba) through starvation-induced encystment with speed and sphericity per frame; add cortical-tension measurements from the literature as a separate variable.
obstacles_confirmed: Cell state labels and tension measurements are rarely both present.
Images are anecdotal relative to a survey of naked cells.
Activity and 'rest' are often inferred from the shape being explained.
